cards.english_title: Delhi Rally Brings Traffic Curbs and Political Tension
cards.korean_desc: INDIA 연합은 2026년 11월 1일 집회한다. 행진은 민토 로드에서 시작해 행사장에 간다. 델리 경찰은 오전 10시부터 오후 5시까지 통제한다. 차량은 막히고 응급차는 별도 통로를 이용한다.
cards.english_desc: The INDIA bloc will rally at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan on November 1, 2026. The march will start near Minto Road and Connaught Place before reaching the venue. Delhi Police will restrict traffic from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. around central intersections. Commuters may face congestion on several roads, while emergency vehicles will receive a separate passage.
cards.hook: Delhi rally plans bring traffic curbs.
cards.takeaway_english: The rally’s political message now arrives with a practical travel warning.
cards.takeaway_korean: 정치적 메시지와 교통 경고가 함께 나왔다.

why_it_matters.english: Commuters may need different routes through central Delhi.
why_it_matters.korean: 시민들은 델리에서 다른 길을 찾아야 한다.

why_it_matters.english: The rally keeps election rules and voter rolls in public debate.
why_it_matters.korean: 집회는 선거 명부 문제를 계속 알린다.

views.korean: 야당은 선거 문제에 항의해야 한다고 본다.

disagree.english: Critics may say the claims remain political allegations, while organizers may say public protest is necessary.

cards.english_title: Tata Motors Takes Control of Iveco
cards.korean_desc: 인수로 타타의 세계 상용차 사업이 커진다. 타타의 네덜란드 자회사가 주당 14.40유로를 냈다. 찬드라세카란은 회장이고 퍼손은 최고경영자다. 추가 주식은 2026년 11월 13일 결제된다.
cards.english_desc: The purchase gives Tata a larger position in global commercial vehicles. The offer paid €14.40 per share through Tata’s wholly owned Dutch subsidiary. N. Chandrasekaran is Iveco’s Chairperson, while Olof Persson remains Chief Executive Officer. Shares tendered during the reopening will be settled on November 13, 2026.
cards.takeaway_english: The takeover is completed enough to change Iveco’s leadership, but not every ownership step is finished.
cards.takeaway_korean: 경영진은 바뀌었지만 소유 절차는 끝나지 않았다.

why_it_matters.english: The deal changes control of a major commercial-vehicle company.
Remaining shareholders still face another tender window in November.
why_it_matters.korean: 남은 주주는 11월에 다시 주식을 팔 수 있다.

parties.english: It acquired 89.42% of Iveco’s common shares.

views.korean: 인수는 타타의 세계 상용차 사업을 키운다.

views.label: Business Standard
views.english: The deal brings Iveco under Tata’s control, but buying out remaining minority shareholders continues.
views.korean: 타타가 지배하지만 소수 주주 인수는 계속된다.

cards.english_title: TARA Turns Fashion Waste Into Hands-On Craft
cards.korean_desc: 디자이너 카리시마의 TARA가 뭄바이에서 열린다. 무료 전시는 카샤와 하트 투 하트의 과정을 설명한다. 방문객은 옷을 뒤집고 천 꽃을 만든다. 카리시마는 사람들이 옷을 더 깊이 생각하길 바란다.
cards.english_desc: Designer Karishma Shahani Khan’s TARA is open at 47-A in Mumbai until November 8, 2026. The free showcase explains how clothing, objects and waste move through Ka-Sha and Heart to Haat. Visitors can turn garments inside out, watch films and make fabric flowers from old clothes. Karishma hopes the experience encourages slower, more thoughtful relationships with clothing.
cards.hook: TARA lets visitors enter fashion’s hidden labor.
cards.takeaway_english: TARA treats clothing less like a product and more like a process people can understand.

why_it_matters.english: Visitors see how materials become clothing instead of seeing only finished products.
why_it_matters.korean: 방문객은 재료가 옷이 되는 과정을 본다.

why_it_matters.english: The exhibit connects waste reduction with Indian craft knowledge.
why_it_matters.korean: 전시는 폐기물 감소와 인도 공예를 잇는다.

parties.label: Karishma Shahani Khan
parties.english: She created TARA to reveal fashion’s materials, labor and making process.

parties.label: Visitors
parties.english: They can handle garments, watch studio films and make fabric flowers.
parties.korean: 옷을 만지고 천 꽃을 만들 수 있다.

parties.label: Heart to Haat
parties.english: It turns Ka-Sha’s production waste into products without adding new materials.

views.label: Karishma Shahani Khan
views.english: Fashion should show its labor and avoid using sustainability merely as a sales slogan.
views.korean: 패션은 노동을 보여주고 지속가능성을 팔이로 쓰면 안 된다.

views.label: The Voice of Fashion
views.english: TARA invites visitors to understand handmade clothing through touch, craft and time.
views.korean: TARA는 손길과 시간으로 수공예 옷을 보여준다.

disagree.english: Some visitors may still ask how much wider fashion production can change through individual experiments.
disagree.korean: 일부는 작은 실험이 산업을 얼마나 바꿀지 물을 수 있다.

cards.english_title: Sarthak Takes Pole With a Record Lap
cards.korean_desc: 푸네의 사르타크가 2026년 10월 30일 폴을 차지했다. 그 결과는 전국 대회 3라운드 생일에 나왔다. 그는 금요일 예선에서 슈퍼 스포츠 301-400cc를 이끌었다. 앤 제니퍼와 마타나 쿠마르도 각 부문 1위였다. 토요일 경주가 예선 1위의 승리를 결정한다.
cards.english_desc: Pune’s Sarthak Chavan took pole with a record lap at Chennai’s Madras International Circuit on October 30, 2026. The result came on his 20th birthday during round three of the national racing challenge. He led the Super Sport 301-400cc Open class during Friday qualifying. Ann Jennifer and Mathana Kumar also qualified first in their respective classes. Saturday’s races will decide whether qualifying leaders can convert their starts into wins.
cards.hook: Sarthak turned his 20th birthday into pole position.
cards.takeaway_english: Sarthak starts Saturday with the advantage, but the race itself still awaits.
cards.takeaway_korean: 사르타크가 유리하지만 실제 경기는 아직 남았다.

why_it_matters.english: Pole position gives riders the first starting place in a competitive race.
why_it_matters.korean: 폴 포지션은 경기에서 첫 출발 자리를 준다.

why_it_matters.english: The results show riders from several Indian cities competing nationally.
why_it_matters.korean: 여러 인도 도시 선수가 전국 대회에서 경쟁한다.

parties.label: Sarthak Chavan
parties.english: He qualified first with a record lap in the premier Super Sport class.

parties.label: Ann Jennifer
parties.english: She took pole in the Super Stock 165cc Intermediate class.

parties.label: Rajender Beedani
parties.english: He took pole in Pro-Stock 200cc and the Expert one-make class.
parties.korean: 프로 스톡과 전문가 부문에서 폴을 차지했다.

views.label: Khelangan
views.english: Sarthak’s record pole was the standout result of qualifying at Madras International Circuit.

views.label: UNI India
views.english: His 1:47.251 lap beat the earlier 1:47.291 practice mark.

disagree.english: Qualifying success does not decide Saturday’s race, where every rider still has to finish the contest.
disagree.korean: 예선 1위가 토요일 경기 승리를 보장하지는 않는다.

cards.english_title: Sanjay Gupta, Known for Crime Thrillers, Dies at 57
cards.korean_desc: 힌디어 감독 산제이 굽타가 2026년 10월 30일 숨졌다. 판디트는 장례 세부 사항을 나중에 알리겠다고 했다. 굽타의 대표작은 칸테, 카빌, 슛아웃 앳 와달라다.
cards.english_desc: Hindi filmmaker Sanjay Gupta died at home on October 30, 2026, aged 57. Pandit said details of Gupta’s last rites would be shared later. Gupta’s best-known films include Kaante, Kaabil and Shootout at Wadala.
cards.hook: Sanjay Gupta died at 57 after a head injury.
cards.takeaway_english: Gupta’s films remain the clearest record of the cinematic style he built over three decades.

why_it_matters.english: His films shaped a recognizable style of Hindi crime and action cinema.
why_it_matters.korean: 그의 영화는 힌디어 범죄 영화에 영향을 줬다.

why_it_matters.english: His death closes a career that lasted from 1994 through 2024.

parties.label: Sanjay Gupta
parties.english: He directed crime thrillers including Shootout at Wadala, Kaabil and Kaante.

parties.label: Ashoke Pandit
parties.english: He confirmed Gupta’s death and said details of the last rites would follow.
parties.korean: 그가 사망했다고 확인하고 장례를 알리겠다고 했다.

parties.label: Hindi film industry
parties.english: It lost a filmmaker whose career began with Aatish: Feel the Fire in 1994.

views.label: Ashoke Pandit
views.english: He described Gupta as a passionate filmmaker and a major loss to the industry.
views.korean: 굽타는 열정적인 감독이자 업계의 큰 손실이라고 했다.

views.label: Times of India
views.english: It reported the death but said no cause had yet been shared by family sources.
views.korean: 가족이 사인을 아직 밝히지 않았다고 보도했다.

disagree.english: Accounts differ on the precise circumstances, so the confirmed facts are his death, age and reported head injury.
disagree.korean: 정확한 상황은 엇갈리므로 사망과 나이만 확인됐다.

cards.english_title: G20 Talks End Without Consensus on Wars and Trade
cards.korean_desc: 우크라이나 전쟁이 갈랐고 유럽은 러시아 사진 참석에 반대했다. 다른 갈등은 이란, 관세, 중국 해역, 남아공 초청 문제다. 마르코 루비오는 공동성명 대신 의장 성명을 낸다. 회원국들은 갈등 속에서도 12월 플로리다 정상회의를 준비한다.
cards.english_desc: Russia’s war with Ukraine divided members, and Europeans objected to Russia’s place in the group photo. Other disputes involve Iran, U.S. tariffs, China’s maritime actions and South Africa’s invitation. Marco Rubio will issue a chairman’s statement instead of a joint communique. Members will try to make December’s Florida leaders’ summit successful despite the divisions.
cards.hook: G20 ministers will leave Atlanta without consensus.
cards.sticker: What the ministers could not agree
cards.takeaway_english: The Atlanta meeting shows how wars can crowd even economic diplomacy out of the room.
cards.takeaway_korean: 애틀랜타 회의는 전쟁이 경제 외교를 막는 모습을 보였다.

why_it_matters.english: Disagreements are linked to fuel costs and uncertainty about trade.
why_it_matters.korean: 갈등은 연료비와 무역 불확실성에 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: The same disputes may shape December’s leaders’ summit.

parties.label: G20 foreign ministers
parties.english: They will finish Atlanta talks without a joint communique on key security issues.
parties.korean: 핵심 안보 문제의 공동성명 없이 끝낸다.

parties.label: Marco Rubio
parties.english: He will issue a chairman’s statement summarizing the discussions.

parties.label: European diplomats
parties.english: They objected to Russia’s presence in the traditional group photograph.
parties.korean: 러시아 참석에 반대해 단체 사진을 거부했다.

views.label: Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski
views.english: He says wars and wartime participants make agreement on a common line very difficult.
views.korean: 전쟁과 당사국 때문에 공통 입장이 어렵다고 말했다.

views.label: U.S. officials
views.english: They say members can still work through differences before December’s leaders’ summit.
views.korean: 12월 정상회의 전까지 차이를 좁힐 수 있다고 본다.

disagree.english: Critics may argue that replacing a joint communique shows the forum cannot resolve its deepest conflicts.
disagree.korean: 비판자들은 공동성명 부재가 G20의 한계를 보인다고 말할 수 있다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 정치적 갈등 속에서도 경제 협력이 가능할까요?

sources.title: G20 foreign ministers to end Atlanta meeting without consensus on key issues

sentences.english: Russia’s war with Ukraine divided members, and Europeans objected to Russia’s place in the group photo.
sentences.korean: 우크라이나 전쟁이 갈랐고 유럽은 러시아 사진 참석에 반대했다.

sentences.english: Other disputes involve Iran, U.S. tariffs, China’s maritime actions and South Africa’s invitation.
sentences.korean: 다른 갈등은 이란, 관세, 중국 해역, 남아공 초청 문제다.

sentences.english: Marco Rubio will issue a chairman’s statement instead of a joint communique.
sentences.korean: 마르코 루비오는 공동성명 대신 의장 성명을 낸다.

sentences.english: Members will try to make December’s Florida leaders’ summit successful despite the divisions.
sentences.korean: 회원국들은 갈등 속에서도 12월 플로리다 정상회의를 준비한다.
